articles.title: India Just Abolished All Taxes on Foreign Bond Investment. One Billion Dollars Flowed In Within Three Days.
articles.excerpt: The tax exemption and expanded market access are designed to lure back foreign capital and lock in a spot in the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Index. Here is what it means for NRI investors.

articles.nri_angle: NRI investors stand to benefit directly from expanded access to Indian government bonds and the removal of tax barriers — the reforms also strengthen the case for FCNR deposits and may stabilise the rupee that has hit their remittance calculations hard this year.

articles.title: India Is About to Flood the Market With $6 Billion in New Shares. Here Is What Every NRI Investor Needs to Know.
articles.excerpt: Zepto just filed for $837 million. NSE is close behind at $2.5 billion. Jio looms. And 163 companies already have SEBI approval. The second half of 2026 could reshape India's equity market.

articles.nri_angle: NRIs need PIS accounts, awareness of FEMA sectoral caps, and DTAA documentation to participate in India's IPO wave. Setup takes weeks — start now before marquee listings like Zepto and NSE open.

articles.title: Trump Just Cut Tariffs on India to 18 Per Cent. Here Is What Every NRI Needs to Know Before the July 9 Deadline.
articles.excerpt: The first tranche of a bilateral trade agreement is taking shape. India is pushing for full exemption from the 26 per cent reciprocal tariff while protecting agriculture and dairy. The clock runs out in four weeks.
articles.image_caption: President Donald Trump meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi at a bilateral summit
articles.nri_angle: NRIs with money in both countries face a four-week hedging window before the July 9 tariff deadline. The deal directly affects remittance families, IT sector workers via digital services provisions, and anyone who buys gold in India. India's dual strategy — US deal plus EU trade pact — signals a country negotiating from strength, which reshapes the financial landscape for the eight million NRIs in America.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

The move is designed to stop the rupee's slide — but it also reshapes the math for every NRI weighing Indian debt exposure.
